National pharmacovigilance system / PPB reporting system

note: A regulator's guideline (Revision 02, effective 2026, review 2029) setting requirements for digital pharmacy platforms. It prescribes what those platforms must do and which national shared services they must connect to; it states nothing about any HMIS or EMR in use, at any tier, so no fact. 'EMR' and 'EHR' appear only in the abbreviations list and in general background.
